_comment: S1 selection-read ratchet. Each entry is a DOM selection read outside packages/rendering/dom/src/field-editor/selectionReader.ts, with the requirement that removes it. An entry whose read no longer exists fails (I15); the list only shrinks and W3.G2 closes at entries: [].

entries.reason: the mouseup path maps the live selection, because a multi-click's word or paragraph expansion reaches selectionchange after pointer-settled closes the pointer window in Chromium, so the reader alone would refuse it (r-multi-click scenario); W3.R12 reads multi-click through the reader with no frame wait (D19) or computes the expansion in core
an active table cell's input range reads its field, because the cell caret is not in the authority yet
applyTextDiffAsOps takes the caret the browser left after its own edit (composition end, mutation diff) before the diff reaches the model, so the reader cannot map it yet; C2 per D3 replaces the path
the contenteditable keydown range for handleFieldEditorKeyDown's inline-atom arrow path; W35 deletes that path with keyHandlingInlineAtoms (D11)

a field activated without a caret in the authority (activate() writes none) takes its input range from the browser's caret; the input's own apply then writes the authority. Goes when activation commits a caret like focus() does
the EditContext backend's PH1 read intercept maps the live DOM selection inside its field to sync the EditContext buffer selection; the reader maps
backend reads the native selection in its selectionchange path; the reader owns it
